title: Neural Eigenfluid Bases: Spectral Objectives, Gauge, and Topology
abstract: arXiv:2610.33925v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reduced-order models simplify fluid simulation by representing complex flows with a small number of spatial modes. Building on Laplacian Eigenfluids, we introduce Neural Eigenfluid Bases (NEB), a neural representation whose basis functions can be evaluated anywhere in space. We enforce incompressibility and impermeable boundaries directly through differential lifts and potential boundary conditions. Geometry-local orthogonalization and Rayleigh minimization then learn an ordered basis. We connect learning in potential and velocity spaces, and derive a spectral-variance relation explaining why these objectives weight approximate modes differently, even though their exact positive spectra agree. Gauge fixing reduces the number of spatial derivatives needed for potential learning, while a Dirichlet energy loss learns independent circulation fields around obstacles. With 1024 modes, both objectives keep velocity errors below 1% in periodic

translated_title: 神经特征流体基：谱目标、规范与拓扑
translated_abstract: 降阶模型通过用少量空间模态表示复杂流动来简化流体模拟。在拉普拉斯特征流体（Laplacian Eigenfluids）的基础上，我们提出了神经特征流体基，这是一种基函数可在空间任意位置求值的神经表示。我们通过微分提升和势边界条件直接施加不可压缩性与不可渗透边界约束，进而通过几何局部正交化和瑞利最小化学习有序基。我们建立了势空间与速度空间学习之间的联系，并推导出一种谱-方差关系，解释了为什么这些目标函数对近似模态赋予不同的权重，尽管它们精确的正谱是一致的。规范固定减少了势学习所需的空间导数数量，而狄利克雷能量损失则学习障碍物周围独立的环流场。在1024个模态下，两种目标在周期性场景中均将速度误差保持在1%以下。
tldr: 该论文提出神经特征流体基（NEB），一种基函数可在空间任意位置求值的神经表示，通过谱目标、规范固定与拓扑方法学习有序基，实现不可压缩流体的高精度降阶模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Neural Eigenfluid Bases (NEB), a neural representation with spatially evaluable basis functions that learns ordered bases through spectral objectives, gauge fixing, and topology, enabling accurate reduced-order simulation of incompressible fluids.
